name: Edge AI Engineer
description: Deploy LLMs, speech recognition, image generation, and ONNX models on edge devices. Optimize for memory-constrained environments.
example_snippet:
program EdgeChat:
    keep Cfg as llm config
    put "cpu" into Cfg.backend
    put 2048 into Cfg.context_size

    keep Model as llm handle
    attempt call dictum_llm_load with "llama-3b.gguf" and Cfg and Model
    on success
        keep Reply as text
        call dictum_llm_chat with Model and "user" and "What is edge AI?" giving Reply
        print the text "AI: " and Reply and newline
        call dictum_llm_unload with Model
    on failure with Err
        print the text "Failed to load model: " and Err and newline
    end attempt
end program
